summary: Specified the mobile property-first search flow from administrative area selection to editable map-based building confirmation.

acceptance.criterion: The brief makes property/building search the default mode and defines the city-to-neighbourhood, map, pin, and editable confirmation flow.
acceptance.evidence: The screen opens in Ev / bina ara mode and specifies city, district, neighbourhood, map selection, detail editing, and confirmation.

acceptance.criterion: The brief covers the map and selection states needed by designers without inventing backend data behavior.
acceptance.evidence: It defines UI states while explicitly deferring map provider, geocoding, and identity contracts.

acceptance.criterion: The brief specifies mobile interaction, accessibility, and open decisions.
acceptance.evidence: Mobile interaction, non-map alternative, permission behavior, and open decisions are separately recorded.

checks.name: documentation whitespace check
checks.evidence: git diff --check completed successfully with no output.

risks: Building identity and administrative location data contracts still require separate backend/geo discovery.
followUps: Design the separate location-confirmation screen after its data contract is defined.
